about_the_game:
You are a former WWII soldier, now living a quiet life with your wife in your cozy home. But peace is an illusion. The war never truly ended for you. The echoes of the past manifest in terrifying ways—hallucinations that warp your world into something unrecognizable.

Your only chance at survival? Run. Find your medicine. Drown out the voices with music. Do whatever it takes to suppress the visions before they consume you entirely.

You are not alone in this house!

Step Into a 1950s Nightmare

Set in a 1950s home, The Dinner immerses you in an era of post-war domestic life-one that should feel safe and familiar, yet is anything but. The game's visual style is designed to resemble film footage from the time, presented in stark black and white with film grain and subtle imperfections, as if viewed through the lens of an old camera.

A Normal Day… Until It’s Not

  • Daily Routines Turned Uncanny – Start your day with simple household tasks: washing dishes, setting the table, cleaning mirrors. But something always feels off.

  • Unsettling Hallucinations – Visual distortions creep into your reality. Shadows shift, objects change, and figures appear where they shouldn’t. Take your medication before the visions consume you.

  • Sound vs. Sanity – The voices in your head won’t stop. The only way to drown them out is through your trusted record player. Music is your only refuge.

  • A Slow Descent Into Horror – As the day progresses, the comfort of routine begins to unravel. What starts as a quiet dinner at home spirals into an unthinkable nightmare.

  • Narrative-Driven Psychological Horror – A linear story with a disturbing ending.

Mature Content Description

This game contains intense psychological horror themes, depictions of PTSD, hallucinations, and unsettling imagery. There are sequences of paranoia behavior, including mentions of substance dependency (medication) to manage mental health issues. Players sensitive to themes of psychological distress, war trauma, or violence should be advised.

Are you ready for The Dinner?

short_description: In 1950, a war veteran living in a house that should feel like home is haunted by eerie hallucinations and a suffocating sense of dread, and must fight to keep his sanity intact. The horror is more real than it seems...
